description: Search the public GrantCue grant catalog (federal, state, local and foundation opportunities) with the same filters as the Discover page. Returns a short page of matches, at most 25, and can reach the first 100 results of a search. Grant text is provided by the funders.

applicant_type.description: Who is applying. Grants that exclude this kind of applicant are left out.

due_in_days.description: Only grants closing within this many days.

location.description: A place page slug such as "allegheny-county-pa" to limit results to grants open there.

max_funding.description: Largest award or total, in US dollars.

min_funding.description: Smallest award or total, in US dollars.

offset.description: Skip this many results, to page through. Only the first 100 results of a search can be reached.

query.description: Keywords, an opportunity number, or a quoted phrase.

sort.description: relevance = best match for the query, due_soon = closing soonest, newest = most recently opened. Default: relevance when there is a query, otherwise due_soon.

status.description: posted = open for applications now, forecasted = announced but not yet open. Default: both.

name: search_grants
title: Search grants
